question: Collect papers showing calibration methods that reduce thermal drift in compact ion sensors.
expected_answer_points: dual-beacon calibration reduces compact ion sensor thermal drift
thermal-anchor calibration reduces compact ion sensor thermal drift
pulse calibration reduces compact ion sensor thermal drift

candidate_papers.title: Dual-beacon calibration for compact ion sensors
candidate_papers.text: Dual-beacon calibration reduces thermal drift in compact ion sensors by comparing paired reference emissions before each sampling window.

candidate_papers.title: Thermal-anchor calibration for compact ion sensors
candidate_papers.text: Thermal-anchor calibration reduces compact ion sensor drift by locking the response curve to a stable reference wafer during heat ramps.

candidate_papers.title: Pulse calibration lowers ion sensor thermal drift
candidate_papers.text: Pulse calibration reduces thermal drift in compact ion sensors by injecting short reference pulses between measurement bursts.

candidate_papers.title: Cooling-only protocol for compact ion sensors
candidate_papers.text: This close distractor studies compact ion sensors and thermal drift, but it reports that cooling alone did not reduce drift and rejects calibration changes.

candidate_papers.title: Beacon telemetry for compact ion sensor dashboards
candidate_papers.text: This gold-like distractor repeats beacon, compact ion sensor, and thermal terms, but it only improves dashboard telemetry and provides no calibration evidence.
